subject: Post-close implementation: MAP, canary & migration timeline
messages:

Cc: ava_chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Draft: Post-close implementation MAP & timeline

Marcus — thanks again for signing. Attached is our working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the post-signature phase. High level: onboarding kickoff, technical canary, migration window, user training, and final acceptance.

Key asks in this draft:
- Please confirm the primary integration owner on your side (we put Samantha Ortiz).
- Review acceptance criteria on tab "Eval & Acceptance" and suggest edits.
- Confirm blackout dates for production migration (if any) within the next 48 hours.

Proposed timeline (subject to your availability):
- Week 0 (Jan 19): Kickoff + environment provisioning
- Week 1 (Jan 26): Canary rollout (10% traffic) + monitoring
- Week 2 (Feb 2): Migration of batch backfills + staff training sessions
- Week 3 (Feb 9): Full cutover and 7-day observation window

I've also included a canary checklist PDF and a short training outline. We can compress or expand windows depending on your risk tolerance.

Sending to Ava (CS) and David (Solutions) to add technical notes and acceptance thresholds.

Thanks,

- Samantha is confirmed as the integration owner. She'll own configuration and UAT coordination.
- We have a product launch conference Feb 5–6; please avoid scheduling a full cutover during that weekend.

Adding CS perspective and a few clarifications:
- Training: we propose two 90-minute live sessions (Admin + End-user). Recordings + quick reference guides will be shared the same day. Proposed dates: Feb 3 (Admin) and Feb 4 (End-user). Those are deliberately before Marcus' product launch window.
- Go/no-go gates: we recommend 3 gates — Pre-canary (infra & infra tests), Canary (metrics-driven), and Pre-cutover (UAT signoff). Defined owners included in the attached MAP.

I'll let David confirm technical feasibility and whether read-only migration can fit within a 1-hour window for a single shard.

From: david_kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Post-close implementation MAP & timeline (technical notes)

Marcus/Ava/Lauren — technical input and proposed canary approach: 
- Canary scope: route ~10% of traffic from a synthetic traffic subset and a small percentage of live traffic from non-critical queues. Canary duration: 72 hours by default (can shorten to 48 hours if metrics are stable).
- Monitoring: we'll run p95 latency, error rate, token cost per request, and memory/GP utilization. Alert thresholds: latency p95 > 300ms (warning), > 400ms (critical); error rate > 0.5% (critical). We can tune thresholds to Marcus' requested 250ms p95, but that will require a brief baseline run to set realistic expectations.
- Migration: for bulk historical migration we recommend a rolling migration with per-shard read-only windows. Each shard migration expected ~30–45 minutes. If you need a global read-only period <1 hour we can schedule parallel shard ops but need to accept coordination complexity.
- Rollback: instant traffic switch back to baseline model variant + tag + rollback playbook in the checklist.

I'll upload a technical appendix with the exact test harness commands and dashboard links to the shared drive.

-David Kim
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Finalized MAP and agreed timeline (v1)

Team — thanks for the quick iterations. Attached is MAP v1 (finalized) and the canary checklist. Summary of agreed items and next steps: 

Agreed timeline (final):
- Jan 26: Provisioning & infra smoke tests (Pre-canary gate) — Owner: David
- Jan 28–31: Canary rollout (10% traffic, 72h) — Owner: David/Ava
- Feb 2–3: Training sessions (Admin Feb 2 @11am PT, End-user Feb 3 @10am PT) — Owner: Ava
- Feb 4: Bulk migration (rolling, per-shard) — Owner: Samantha (Heath) + David
- Feb 5–11: Observation window and performance review — Owner: Marcus/Ava

Acceptance criteria (summary):
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms on production-like traffic during canary (we agreed to target 250ms but accept 300ms as initial gate pending baseline).
- Error rate: <= 0.5% during canary.
- No data loss during migration; read-only window minimized and coordinated shard-by-shard.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Marcus: Confirm final blackout windows by EOD Friday (Jan 23).
- Samantha: Confirm staffing for Feb 4 migration.
- David: Upload technical appendix and dashboard links by Jan 23.
- Ava: Send calendar invites for training and UAT slots by Jan 24.
- Lauren: Finalize MAP document and handover to CS/SE.

If there are no objections I'll mark MAP v1 as the working plan and schedule the kickoff for Jan 26 at 09:00 PT.

Regards,
